This transformation always introduces a ConditionByFormula or 191 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 a AttributeValueVariationPoint , i.e., an element that has an attribute bindingTime .
